palettes.name: Light neutral
palettes.intent: For a quiet reading utility: contrast and grouping lead, with no brand accent required.
palettes.counterexample: If collection identity is essential, neutral surfaces alone may not distinguish it.

palettes.name: Dark neutral
palettes.intent: For a requested dark reading surface, using independently chosen values and a lighter primary action.
palettes.counterexample: Dark appearance may be inappropriate for the audience or supplied artwork; it is not an automatic upgrade.

palettes.name: Restrained terracotta
palettes.intent: A hypothetical independent publication identity gives the primary action a warm material association.
palettes.counterexample: An unrelated brand should not inherit this tint merely because it looks restrained.

palettes.name: Expressive field
palettes.intent: A hypothetical culture journal uses a large vivid field while the working surface stays readable and the action uses dark text.
palettes.counterexample: The surrounding color can dominate a long work session; compare it against a neutral canvas before choosing it.
